description: Search the New Jersey Statutes (N.J.S.A.) BY TOPIC or keyword rather than citation — "security deposit interest", "landlord grounds for eviction", "possession of weapons for unlawful purposes". Returns ranked sections with their citations (where parseable) and headings; use nj_statute_section afterward for the full text of one. Full-text search, so it answers questions no citation lookup can. Keyless.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "security deposit interest". A few plain words works better than a long sentence — this engine ANDs every word.

name: nj_statute_search
title: Nj Statute Search
